metadata.description: antigravity-obsidian: an Antigravity-CLI fork of claude-obsidian (AgriciDaniel, MIT). A self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian that runs under Antigravity CLI (agy) and Claude Code. Persistent, compounding wiki vault of plain Markdown you own, based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.

plugins.name: antigravity-obsidian
plugins.description: Antigravity-CLI fork of claude-obsidian (AgriciDaniel, MIT) — adds Antigravity CLI (agy) support alongside Claude Code. Claude + Obsidian knowledge companion: persistent compounding wiki vault, Obsidian CLI transport, hybrid retrieval (BM25 + cosine rerank per Anthropic's Sept 2024 research), per-file advisory locking for multi-writer safety, pre-commit verifier agent, methodology modes (LYT / PARA / Zettelkasten / Generic). Optional DragonScale Memory extension. Underlying LLM-Wiki system by AgriciDaniel; pairs with kepano/obsidian-skills.
